Do we get them before or after they meet?|attr=[[Zayl Braith]], [[Callandri]], and [[Rodick Tag]]|src=<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>}}
The '''Zanitar''' was a location where the [[Granse Confederacy]] planned to ambush two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who were buying [[Data-tape/Legends|datatapes]] with information on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] movements from [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. [[Callandri]], leader of the Granse Confederacy, intended the ambush as a purely professional matter but was hopeful that the action would draw the attention of [[Alton Lochner]] and his companions.
